# toPageOrientation

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`PageOrientationInput`](page-orientation-input.md) to the [`PageOrientation`](page-orientation.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toPageOrientation(input: PageOrientation | PageOrientationToken): PageOrientation
```
